summary_en: 93,800 shares (0.7% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-21 at ¥751/share closing price, ¥70.44M upper limit. Settlement following market close at 08:45 JST.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Repurchase via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Yappli announced on 2026-08-20 that its board has authorized the acquisition of 93,800 treasury shares (0.7% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 2026-08-21. The shares will be bought at ¥751 per share (the day's closing price), with a total upper limit of ¥70,443,800. The order is valid only during the designated trading window (08:45 JST) and will be settled immediately following market close. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. Completion of the full purchase amount is not guaranteed; execution may be partial or zero depending on market conditions.
